summary: garage_sectional / detached garage door: missing_hardware; other_obviously_wrong

findings.description: There is no wall between the top of the door opening and the header: a 2.21 m tall hole the full width of the opening, open to the sky. The hole exists so the leaf can slide up inside the wall plane without interpenetrating it.
The caption says the pull_t_handle_garage is on both sides. Only one face carries it: the other hardware close-up shows a blank leaf. A robot approaching from that side has nothing to take hold of.
